# harmonysase_standard_gateway (Data Source)

Look up an existing Harmony SASE gateway (instance) by network ID and gateway ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harmonysase_standard_gateway" "lookup" {
  network_id = harmonysase_standard_network.main.id
  id         = "<gateway_id>"
}

output "gateway_ip" {
  value = data.harmonysase_standard_gateway.lookup.ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Gateway (instance) ID.
- `network_id` (String) ID of the parent network.

### Read-Only

- `dns` (String)
- `image_type` (String)
- `image_version` (String)
- `instance_type` (String)
- `ip` (String)
- `region_id` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
